name: ultimate-td
description: Ultimate TD prototype: tests and art tools. The game itself needs no install.

scripts.test: for f in tests/*.cjs; do node "$f" >/dev/null || { echo "FAIL $f"; exit 1; }; done; echo 'all tests passed'
scripts.test:slow: for f in tests/slow/*.cjs; do node "$f" >/dev/null || { echo "FAIL $f"; exit 1; }; done; echo 'all slow tests passed'
